subject.title: fix(ui): apply Context Profile presets via config.patch to avoid SecretRef rejection

question: Should Context Profile presets persist their three owned settings immediately through `config.patch` while unrelated form and raw-editor edits remain staged for the shared save/apply workflow?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and follows the documented partial-update RPC, but it intentionally creates a separate persistence boundary inside the settings UI that automated review cannot designate as the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve bounded partial writes
options.body: Accept presets as an explicit direct-write control after the branch is rebased and its staged-edit reconciliation is re-proven against current main.

options.title: Require one shared save path
options.body: Rework SecretRef round-tripping so presets remain staged and all Control UI changes continue through the common full-config submission workflow.

options.title: Pause the preset repair
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while owners decide whether Context Profiles should remain a first-class persisted preset surface.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded partial writes
recommendation.body: Accept presets as an explicit direct-write control after the branch is rebased and its staged-edit reconciliation is re-proven against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly intersects the SecretRef restoration and config-write contract established by this person's merged work.
